meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 执行后,你的 Mac 菜单栏会出现一个闪电图标。绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行,红点表示已停止;点击图标可开始、停止或重启服务,还可查看日志。
howto.when: 当你说要“给 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态图标”时,或直接输入 /add-macos-statusbar 时,这个技能会开始执行。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加一个 macOS 菜单栏状态图标。
say.note: 触发技能的环境检查和安装。

say.text: 帮我加个闪电图标,显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行。
say.note: 安装后点图标就能开始、停止或重启。

say.text: 在菜单栏装一个 NanoClaw 的状态灯。
say.note: 技能会编译并加载后台服务。

howto.what_en: After setup, a bolt icon appears in your macOS menu bar. A green dot means NanoClaw is running; a red dot means it's stopped. Click the icon to start, stop, or restart the service, and to view logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw, or when you type /add-macos-statusbar.

say_en.text: Add a macOS menu bar status icon for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Triggers the skill's environment check and install.

say_en.text: Add a bolt icon showing whether NanoClaw is running.
say_en.note: After install, click it to start, stop, or restart.

say_en.text: Install a NanoClaw status light in the menu bar.
say_en.note: The skill compiles and loads the backend service.
